schema.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

run_in_background.description: Agents run in the background by default; you will be notified when one completes. Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

isolation.description: Isolation mode. "worktree" creates a temporary git worktree so the agent works on an isolated copy of the repo. "remote" launches the agent in a remote cloud environment (always runs in background; availability is gated).

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds (max 600000 for a foreground command)

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this command in the background. With it, `timeout` limits how long the command may run in the background before it is stopped (default 600000 ms, max 7200000 ms).

dangerouslyDisableSandbox.description: Set this to true to dangerously override sandbox mode and run commands without sandboxing.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description:
Performs exact string replacement in a file.

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

schema.name: Glob
schema.description: Fast file pattern matching. Supports glob patterns like "**/*.js" or "src/**/*.ts". Returns matching file paths sorted by modification time.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used. IMPORTANT: Omit this field to use the default directory. DO NOT enter "undefined" or "null" - simply omit it for the default behavior. Must be a valid directory path if provided.

tools.name: Grep
tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in (rg PATH). Defaults to current working directory.

glob.description: Glob pattern to filter files (e.g. "*.js", "*.{ts,tsx}") - maps to rg --glob

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match (rg -C). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

type.description: File type to search (rg --type). Common types: js, py, rust, go, java, etc. More efficient than include for standard file types.

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N lines/entries, equivalent to "| head -N". Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: ListAgents
tools.description: Lists agents you can SendMessage to — in-process subagents you spawned, the teammates on your team, other local Claude sessions on this machine, your Claude sessions running in the cloud (when this session has cloud access; a cloud session receives your message but cannot message any session back yet — do not ask it to reply, read its answer in its own transcript), and (when Remote Control is connected here) your account's other sessions — Remote Control sessions on other machines and cloud sessions, each row labeled by kind. Names are the address: send with `SendMessage({to: "<name>", message: "..."})`, copying the name exactly as a row prints it. Append a row's ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — two rows share it, or an error asks you to disambiguate.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

pages.description: Page range for PDF files (e.g., "1-5", "3", "10-20"). Only applicable to PDF files. Maximum 20 pages per request.

allow_large.description: Set to true to read a text file, or a line range of one, that is over the usual size limits, up to what still fits in your context. Only use this when you genuinely need all of it or the user asked for the whole file; otherwise read it in parts with offset and limit, or search it.

tools.name: ReportFindings
tools.description: Report code-review findings as a typed list so the host UI can render them. Use this only when the active code-review instructions tell you to report findings with this tool; otherwise follow whatever output format those instructions specify. When reporting a review's results, call it once with the verified findings ranked most-severe first (empty array if nothing survived verification) and do not also print the findings as text. When re-reporting after applying fixes (only if the apply instructions ask for it), set `outcome` on each finding to what actually happened.

level.description: Effort level the review ran at

findings.description: Verified findings, most-severe first; empty if none survived

file.description: Repo-relative path of the file the finding is in

short_summary.description: Compressed label for compact UI (≤60 chars): the claim alone, no rationale or consequence clause

category.description: Short kebab-case slug of the finding type, e.g. "correctness", "simplification", "efficiency", "test-coverage"

verdict.description: Set when a verify pass ran; absent on inline-only reviews

outcome.description: Set ONLY when re-reporting after applying fixes: what happened to this finding

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

1	"""Ulysses sequence parallelism around one DiT attention block, forward and backward.
2	
3	    torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 examples/dit_attention.py
4	
5	Each rank holds a slice of the sequence and all of the heads. The first all-to-all trades that for
6	all of the sequence and a slice of the heads, attention runs on whole sequences, and the second
7	trades back. Both are differentiable, so this is an ordinary module: no autograd.Function wrapper,
8	no manual backward.
9	
10	The run checks itself two ways. It compares against the same block with no sequence parallelism at
11	all -- one rank holding everything -- for both the output and the input gradient. And it prints the
12	loss over a few optimiser steps, because a collective can be bit-exact in a unit test and still be
13	wired into the wrong axis of a real module.
14	
15	The packing matters more than it looks. q, k and v go through ONE collective as a `3 * head_dim`
16	last axis: one handshake instead of three, for the same bytes.
17	"""
18	
19	from __future__ import annotations
20	
21	import os
22	
23	import torch
24	import torch.distributed as dist
25	import torch.nn.functional as F
26	
27	from fast_ulysses import UlyssesGroup
28	
29	B, S_LOCAL, HEADS_PER_RANK, HEAD_DIM = 1, 512, 4, 128
30	
31	
32	class UlyssesAttention(torch.nn.Module):
33	    """One attention block, sequence-parallel over `group`.
34	
35	    Input and output are both (b, s_local, n_global * head_dim): the shard the caller already has.
36	    Everything between the two collectives sees whole sequences and a head shard.
37	    """
38	
39	    def __init__(self, group: UlyssesGroup, n_global: int, head_dim: int) -> None:
40	        super().__init__()
41	        self.group, self.n_global, self.head_dim = group, n_global, head_dim
42	        self.qkv = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, 3 * n_global * head_dim, bias=False)
43	        self.proj = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, n_global * head_dim, bias=False)
44	
45	    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
46	        b, s_local, _ = x.shape
47	
48	        # (b, s_local, n_global, 3 * head_dim) -- q, k, v packed into the last axis so the two
49	        # collectives below stay two collectives.
50	        qkv = self.qkv(x).view(b, s_local, self.n_global, 3 * self.head_dim)
51	
52	        # mode 0: sequence shard -> head shard. Differentiable; its backward is mode 1.
53	        qkv = self.group.all_to_all_4d(qkv, mode=0)  # (b, s_global, n_local, 3 * head_dim)
54	
55	        q, k, v = qkv.chunk(3, dim=-1)
56	        # SDPA wants (b, heads, s, d).
57	        attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
58	            q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
59	        ).transpose(1, 2)  # (b, s_global, n_local, head_dim)
60	
61	        # mode 1: back to a sequence shard, all heads. Its backward is mode 0.
62	        attn = self.group.all_to_all_4d(attn.contiguous(), mode=1)
63	        return self.proj(attn.reshape(b, s_local, self.n_global * self.head_dim))
64	
65	
66	def reference(module: UlyssesAttention, x_global: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
67	    """The same block with no sequence parallelism: one rank, whole sequence, all heads."""
68	    b, s, _ = x_global.shape
69	    qkv = module.qkv(x_global).view(b, s, module.n_global, 3 * module.head_dim)
70	    q, k, v = qkv.chunk(3, dim=-1)
71	    attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
72	        q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
73	    ).transpose(1, 2)
74	    return module.proj(attn.reshape(b, s, module.n_global * module.head_dim))
75	
76	
77	def main() -> None:
78	    dist.init_process_group("nccl")
79	    rank, ws = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
80	    torch.cuda.set_device(int(os.environ.get("LOCAL_RANK", rank)))
81	    dev = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
82	    torch.manual_seed(0)  # same seed on every rank: the weights must match
83	
84	    n_global = HEADS_PER_RANK * ws
85	    block = UlyssesAttention(UlyssesGroup(require_nvlink=False), n_global, HEAD_DIM)
86	    block = block.to(dev, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
87	
88	    # One global sequence, sharded by rank. Built identically everywhere, then sliced, so the
89	    # reference below is over exactly the same data.
90	    s_global = S_LOCAL * ws
91	    x_global = torch.randn(
92	        B, s_global, n_global * HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev
93	    ).requires_grad_(True)
94	    x_local = x_global.detach()[:, rank * S_LOCAL : (rank + 1) * S_LOCAL].requires_grad_(True)
95	
96	    y_local = block(x_local)
97	    y_local.sum().backward()
98	
99	    # The whole point: gather the sharded result and compare, output AND gradient, against the
100	    # single-rank block. allclose, not equal -- attention is not a permutation, and the two paths
101	    # reduce in different orders.
102	    gathered = [torch.empty_like(y_local) for _ in range(ws)]
103	    dist.all_gather(gathered, y_local.detach())
104	    grads = [torch.empty_like(x_local.grad) for _ in range(ws)]
105	    dist.all_gather(grads, x_local.grad)
106	
107	    y_ref = reference(block, x_global)
108	    y_ref.sum().backward()
109	
110	    if rank == 0:
111	        out_err = (torch.cat(gathered, dim=1).float() - y_ref.detach().float()).abs().max().item()
112	        grad_err = (torch.cat(grads, dim=1).float() - x_global.grad.float()).abs().max().item()
113	        tol = 5e-2  # bfloat16 through attention plus two projections
114	        print(f"ws={ws} s_global={s_global} n_global={n_global}")
115	        print(f"  output   max |diff| = {out_err:.4f}  {'OK' if out_err < tol else 'FAIL'}")
116	        print(f"  d/dinput max |diff| = {grad_err:.4f}  {'OK' if grad_err < tol else 'FAIL'}")
117	
118	    # And a few real steps, because being correct once is not the same as training.
119	    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(block.parameters(), lr=1e-3)
120	    target = torch.randn_like(y_local)
121	    for step in range(5):
122	        opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
123	        loss = F.mse_loss(block(x_local), target)
124	        loss.backward()
125	        opt.step()
126	        # One rank's loss, over its own shard of the sequence. The ranks do not agree on it and are
127	        # not meant to: what this shows is that the block trains at all.
128	        if rank == 0:
129	            print(f"  step {step} loss {loss.item():.5f}")
130	
131	    block.group.destroy()
132	    dist.destroy_process_group()
133	
134	
135	if __name__ == "__main__":
136	    main()

2	
3	Coming from DeepSpeed-Ulysses, sglang's `usp.py` or yunchang: what each call becomes here, what your
4	layout costs, and what this library does not have.
5	
6	One structural difference first. All three of those ship an **attention module** —
7	`DistributedAttention`, `UlyssesAttention`, `LongContextAttention` — that owns the q/k/v exchange,
8	the attention call and the output exchange. fast-ulysses ships **only the collective**. You replace
9	one module with two calls and your own attention kernel. `examples/dit_attention.py` is that shape
10	end to end, forward and backward.
11	
12	Left-hand cells below were read from: DeepSpeed `deepspeed/sequence/layer.py` and
13	`deepspeed/runtime/sequence_parallel/ulysses_sp.py`; sglang
14	`python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/layers/usp.py` and
15	`runtime/distributed/{communication_op.py,device_communicators/base_device_communicator.py}`;
16	yunchang `yunchang/comm/all_to_all.py`, `yunchang/ulysses/attn_layer.py`, `yunchang/globals.py` and
17	`yunchang/hybrid/attn_layer.py`. Read on the default branch on 2026-08-10, not from a pinned
18	release; yunchang's default branch and its latest tag, 0.6.4, are identical in `comm/all_to_all.py`.
19	Check your installed version before trusting a row.
20	
21	## The shape of the replacement
22	
23	```python
24	# DeepSpeed
25	from deepspeed.sequence.layer import DistributedAttention
26	
27	self.dist_attn = DistributedAttention(local_attn, sp_group, scatter_idx=2, gather_idx=0)
28	out = self.dist_attn(q, k, v, batch_dim_idx)   # 0 -> (b, s, n, d), 1 -> (s, b, n, d)
29	```
30	
31	```python
32	# here -- qkv packed into the last axis, so two collectives stay two collectives
33	from fast_ulysses import UlyssesGroup
34	
35	group = UlyssesGroup(process_group=sp_group)   # collective; build once, not per call
36	
37	# qkv is this rank's shard, (b, s_local, n_global, 3 * head_dim)
38	qkv = group.all_to_all_4d(qkv, mode=0)   # -> (b, s_global, n_local, 3 * head_dim)
39	q, k, v = qkv.chunk(3, dim=-1)
40	out = local_attn(q, k, v)                # your kernel, on whole sequences
41	out = group.all_to_all_4d(out, mode=1)   # (b, s_global, n_local, hd) -> (b, s_local, n, hd)
42	```
43	
44	## From DeepSpeed-Ulysses
45	
46	| what you write today | what it becomes here |
47	| --- | --- |
48	| `DistributedAttention(local_attn, sp_group, scatter_idx=2, gather_idx=0)` | `UlyssesGroup(process_group=sp_group)` — the collective only; you call `local_attn` yourself |
49	| `dist_attn(q, k, v, batch_dim_idx=0)` | `all_to_all_4d(t, mode=0)` per tensor, or one call on q/k/v packed into a `3 * head_dim` last axis |
50	| `_SeqAllToAll.apply(pg, x, 2, g, batch_dim_idx)` | `group.all_to_all_4d(x, mode=0)` |
51	| `_SeqAllToAll.apply(pg, x, g, 2, batch_dim_idx)` — the output call, indices swapped, `g` in `{0, 1}` | `group.all_to_all_4d(x, mode=1)` |
52	| three `_SeqAllToAll.apply` calls, one each for q, k, v | one call on a `3 * head_dim` last axis: one handshake instead of three, same bytes |
53	| `batch_dim_idx=1`, i.e. `(s, b, n, d)` | not accepted — transpose first, see [Layouts](#layouts) |
54	| `uneven_heads_all2all`, sizes derived from `get_num_kv_heads()`, `assert async_op == False` | `head_splits=[...]` that you pass, on the sync **and** the async call |
55	| `UlyssesSPAttentionHF` (ALST), strictly `(sl, bs, hc, hs)` | not accepted — transpose in and back out, see [Layouts](#layouts) |
56	| the `_SeqAllToAll` `torch.autograd.Function` wrapper | nothing: `all_to_all_4d` is differentiable |
57	| `UlyssesSPDataLoaderAdapter`, `register_with_transformers()`, `UlyssesSPFwdLossBwdWithLogits` | no counterpart — this is a collective, not a training integration |
58	
59	`DistributedAttention.forward`'s fourth parameter is `batch_dim_idx`, positional and required. If
60	your call site passes an attention mask there — the DeepSpeed tutorial snippet and
61	Megatron-DeepSpeed's non-flash branch both do — the layout selection is reading a tensor, and you
62	should settle what that call actually did before porting it.
63	
64	## From sglang `usp.py`
65	
66	| what you write today | what it becomes here |
67	| --- | --- |
68	| `_usp_input_all_to_all(x, head_dim=2)` | `group.all_to_all_4d(x, mode=0)` |
69	| `_usp_output_all_to_all(x, head_dim=2)` | `group.all_to_all_4d(x, mode=1)` |
70	| `_usp_input_all_to_all(x, head_dim=1)`, i.e. `(b, n, s, d)` | not accepted — transpose first, see [Layouts](#layouts) |

72	| `_usp_input_all_to_all_varlen(x, seq_lens, head_dim=2)` and its output form | `seq_splits=seq_lens, head_splits=[n_global // ws] * ws` on the ordinary call; there is no separate varlen entry point |
73	| `sequence_model_parallel_all_to_all_4D(x, scatter_dim=2, gather_dim=1)` | `group.all_to_all_4d(x, mode=0)` |
74	| `DistributedAutograd.AllToAll4D.apply(...)` | nothing: `all_to_all_4d` is differentiable |
75	| `_a2a_staging_buffer(role, shape, dtype, device)`, bypassed when `torch.is_grad_enabled()` | nothing to pass or plumb: windows are cached internally per dtype and stream, with grad on or off |

90	| `all_to_all_4D(x, 2, 1, group=pg)` — the plain function, no grad | `group.all_to_all_4d(x, mode=0)`, which does carry grad |
91	| `all_to_all_5D(x, scatter_idx=3, ...)` on `(bs, s, 3, hc, hs)` | no 5D entry point — fold the qkv axis, see [Layouts](#layouts) |
92	| `use_pack_qkv=True`, `torch.cat([q, k, v])` on the batch axis — the branch then calls `.continous()`, which is not a tensor method, so it raises `AttributeError` before the collective | that cat works unchanged (`b` becomes `3 * b`); packing into `3 * head_dim` is the same one handshake |
93	| `use_sync=True` | no counterpart; nothing here inserts a `torch.cuda.synchronize()` |

95	| a head count that does not divide `world_size` (fails at yunchang's `reshape`) | `head_splits=[...]` |
96	
97	yunchang enforces the index pair — only `(2, 1)` and `(1, 2)` are implemented, anything else raises —
98	so its two directions map one-to-one onto the two modes.
99	
100	## scatter_idx / gather_idx, and mode
101	
102	`mode=0` scatters heads and gathers sequence: `(b, s_local, n_global, d) -> (b, s_global, n_local, d)`.
103	`mode=1` is the inverse.
104	
105	| what selects the direction today | here |
106	| --- | --- |
107	| DeepSpeed `scatter_idx = 2` | `mode=0` |
108	| DeepSpeed `scatter_idx` in `{0, 1}` | `mode=1` |
109	| yunchang `scatter_idx=2, gather_idx=1` | `mode=0` |
110	| yunchang `scatter_idx=1, gather_idx=2` | `mode=1` |
111	| sglang `_usp_input_all_to_all(x, head_dim=2)` | `mode=0` |
112	| sglang `_usp_output_all_to_all(x, head_dim=2)` | `mode=1` |
113	| sglang `scatter_dim=2, gather_dim=1` | `mode=0` |
114	
115	Two traps in the left column:
116	
117	- **DeepSpeed's `gather_idx` does not select the layout on the even path.** It is never passed to
118	  `_generate_layout_params`, and in `single_all_to_all` it is forwarded only to
119	  `uneven_heads_all2all`; the direction is chosen by the predicate `scatter_idx < 2` alone.
120	  `gather_idx` matters only because the output call swaps it into `scatter_idx`. Map by
121	  `scatter_idx`, not by the argument names.
122	- **yunchang's `all_to_all_4D` docstring contradicts its own signature** (it says the defaults are
123	  `scatter_idx=1, gather_idx=2`; the signature is `2, 1`). Read the signature.
124	
125	## Layouts
126	
127	This library takes **4D `(b, s, n, d)` and nothing else.** No 3D form, no 5D form, no
128	`batch_dim_idx`, no `head_dim` argument. That is a real constraint and it is where a migration
129	costs something.
130	
131	| the layout you have | what it costs here |
132	| --- | --- |
133	| `(b, s, n, d)` — sglang `head_dim=2`, yunchang, DeepSpeed `batch_dim_idx=0` | nothing; this is the input |
134	| `(3, s, n, d)` — a q/k/v stack whose dim 0 is not batch | nothing; `b = 3`, and q, k, v are exchanged independently |
135	| `(s, n * d)` contiguous 3D | `x.view(1, s, n, d)` — a view, no copy |
136	| `(b, n, s, d)` — sglang `head_dim=1`, and sglang's default | `x.transpose(1, 2)` in, and back out after the call. Each of those is the size of one of the two permutes this library removes: half the saving goes back if your attention kernel takes the output as a strided view, all of it if it wants contiguous both ways |
137	| `(s, b, n, d)` — Megatron native, DeepSpeed `batch_dim_idx=1`, ALST `UlyssesSPAttentionHF` | `x.transpose(0, 1)` in and back out. Megatron's flash path already pays exactly this (`rearrange("s b ... -> b s ...").contiguous()`) before DeepSpeed's own permutes, so for that caller it is a wash; for ALST, which stays sequence-first end to end, it is a new cost |
138	| `(b, s, 3, n, d)` — yunchang's 5D | fold the qkv axis to `(b, s, n, 3 * d)`, one permute, or emit the projection in that order upstream as `examples/dit_attention.py` does |
139	
140	`.contiguous()` is applied internally, so writing it yourself changes nothing — but a transposed
141	input is copied either way, by you or by the op.
142	
143	The 5D fold has a shortcut that looks right and is not. `(b, s, 3, n, d)` reshapes to
144	`(b, s, 3 * n, d)` for free, but an even split then cuts that merged axis into contiguous chunks, so
145	a rank receives a mixture of q, k and v heads rather than the same head slice of each.
146	
147	## Autograd: there is no wrapper to port
148	
149	DeepSpeed's `_SeqAllToAll` and yunchang's `SeqAllToAll4D` are `torch.autograd.Function`s whose
150	`backward` re-applies the forward with `scatter_idx` and `gather_idx` swapped. `all_to_all_4d` is
151	differentiable in C++, so the wrapper is deleted, not translated: the backward is the other `mode`.
152	
153	The convention differs where it matters. Those libraries express the backward as *swap the two
154	indices*; here it is *the other mode with the **same** splits*. Identical while shards are even,
155	not once they are not — why, in [api.md](api.md).
156	
157	`examples/dit_attention.py` is the worked case — one DiT attention block, sequence-parallel, an
158	ordinary `nn.Module`, checked for both output and input gradient against the same block with no
159	sequence parallelism, then run through five optimiser steps:
160	
161	```bash
162	torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 examples/dit_attention.py
163	```
164	
165	Two exceptions. `all_to_all_4d_async` is not differentiable and raises on a grad-requiring input
166	rather than dropping the gradient silently. `out=` is not differentiable either and raises for the
167	same reason: the value handed back is the caller's own buffer. Both are accepted under
168	`torch.no_grad()`; keep them out of the training graph.
169	
170	## Uneven shards, which is the reason to move
171	
172	| library | uneven support |
173	| --- | --- |
174	| DeepSpeed | heads only, via `uneven_heads_all2all`, with sizes derived from `get_num_kv_heads()` rather than passed by the caller; `assert async_op == False`. No uneven sequence |
175	| sglang `usp.py` | sequence only. `_usp_*_varlen` take `seq_lens`, the group's per-rank sequence shards with `s_local == seq_lens[rank]` asserted, which is what `seq_splits` is. Heads still have to divide: `assert h_global % world_size == 0` |
176	| yunchang | none. `hc // world_size` then a `reshape`, so a non-divisible head count fails at the reshape with no explicit check |
177	| here | `seq_splits` / `head_splits`, both or neither, identical on every rank, on the sync and async calls alike. Even splits are the special case of the same code path, not a fast path beside it |
178	
179	What that buys: sharding a sequence normally means rounding it up to a multiple of the group size,
180	and those padded tokens then ride through attention and both collectives on every layer of every
181	step. Dropping the pad costs the baseline **5–11%** and costs this path **1.00–1.03×** — every
182	shape, every machine. Table in [benchmark.md](benchmark.md), "Removing the sequence padding".
183	
184	## The measured baseline is the path you are leaving
185	
186	The `BASE` column in [benchmark.md](benchmark.md) is not a strawman built for the comparison. It is
187	sglang's `_usp_input_all_to_all(x, head_dim=2)` restated permute for permute —
188	`benchmark/bench_a2a.py:baseline_stages`:
189	
190	```python
191	y = x.permute(2, 0, 1, 3).contiguous().flatten()
192	dist.all_to_all_single(recv, y, group=pg)
193	recv.reshape(ws, h_local, b, s_local, d).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4).contiguous().reshape(...)
194	```
195	
196	`test/distributed/correctness.py:reference_even` holds this operator **bit-exact** against that same
197	path, so the two are checked to be the same function before either is timed. The **1.60–2.17×** in
198	that document, and the per-machine multipliers in the README, are therefore measured against exactly
199	what a sglang or DeepSpeed caller runs today, and the `relayout%` column — **46.9–60.0%** of the
200	baseline — is the two permute kernels that do not exist on this side.
201	
202	Two qualifications, so the number is read for what it is:
203	
204	- The benchmark measures `mode=0`. Upstream sglang's `mode=1` equivalent, `_usp_output_all_to_all`
205	  at `head_dim=2`, already replaces its second permute with a fused CUDA kernel — `usp_merge_heads`
206	  from `sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion.usp_relayout`, JIT-built from `diffusion/usp_relayout.cuh`,
207	  with `x.permute(2, 1, 0, 3, 4).contiguous()` as its own fallback. Its cost was not measured here,
208	  so against *current* sglang the saving on the mode-1 half is smaller than the table implies, by an
209	  unknown amount. Mode 0's two permutes are real on both.
210	- The multiplier moves with world size, for the baseline's reason rather than this operator's — at
211	  ws=4 it is 2.6–2.8× on B200 and 1.7–1.9× on H100. Compare `relayout%` across group sizes, not
212	  the multiplier; the table and the reason are in [benchmark.md](benchmark.md).
213	
214	## What this does not have
215	
216	Check this list before you start, not after.
217	
218	- **Cross-node.** One node. Nothing routes over a NIC.
219	- **PCIe.** `UlyssesGroup()` refuses a group whose GPUs are not NVLink-joined; `require_nvlink=False`
220	  exists to measure that case, not to run in it. Across a CPU socket this path measured 0.62× and
221	  0.14× of `torch.distributed` on two PCIe nodes — if your group is not NVLink-joined, stay where
222	  you are.
223	- **`world_size > 8`.** Structural: `BarPeers::p[8]` in `src/barrier.cu`.
224	- **Ring attention and the ulysses × ring hybrid.** `LongContextAttention` has no counterpart.
225	- **An attention kernel.** No `attn_type`, no kernel selection, no q/k/v plumbing — you call your own.
226	- **`torch.compile` tracing.** A meta kernel propagates shapes under `FakeTensor` and AOTAutograd,
227	  but a module holding an `UlyssesGroup` graph-breaks: the group is a torchbind object with no
228	  registered fake class.
229	- **Autograd on the async form or with `out=`**, and **3D or 5D entry points**.
230	- **dtypes** beyond `float16` / `bfloat16` / `float32` / `float8_e4m3fn` / `float8_e5m2` / `int8` /
231	  `uint8`, with `d * elem_size` 16-byte aligned.
232	
233	## After the switch
234	
235	- **Construction, `empty_output()` and `destroy()` are collective**, and **every rank must issue the
236	  same sequence of shapes and dtypes** — a new shape allocates a window collectively. Violating it
237	  hangs; nothing raises and nothing times out. This is the same discipline the collectives you are
238	  leaving already require, applied to allocation as well as to the call.
239	- Build the group **once** and keep it. It holds the windows, the plan cache and the comm stream.
240	- Pass `out=` from `empty_output()` to remove the copy-out, worth a further 1.14–1.28×. Allocate the
241	  buffer outside the loop; it is collective. **Not in a training graph**: `out=` reaches a mutating
242	  op with no autograd formula, so the result comes back detached and nothing raises. See
243	  [quickstart.md](quickstart.md).

```python
class UlyssesAttention3Calls(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, group, n_global, head_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.group, self.n_global, self.head_dim = group, n_global, head_dim
        self.qkv = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, 3 * n_global * head_dim, bias=False)
        self.proj = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, n_global * head_dim, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s_local, _ = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).view(b, s_local, self.n_global, 3, self.head_dim)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(dim=3)              # 各 (b, s_local, n_global, head_dim)
        q = self.group.all_to_all_4d(q, mode=0)  # 三次握手
        k = self.group.all_to_all_4d(k, mode=0)
        v = self.group.all_to_all_4d(v, mode=0)
        attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
            q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
        ).transpose(1, 2)                        # (b, s_global, n_local, head_dim)
        attn = self.group.all_to_all_4d(attn.contiguous(), mode=1)
        return self.proj(attn.reshape(b, s_local, self.n_global * self.head_dim))
```

def mode0_reference(X, ws):

from __future__ import annotations

import os

import torch
import torch.distributed as dist
import torch.nn.functional as F

from fast_ulysses import UlyssesGroup

B, S_LOCAL, HEADS_PER_RANK, HEAD_DIM = 1, 512, 4, 128


class PackedAttention(torch.nn.Module):
    """与 examples/dit_attention.py 的 UlyssesAttention 相同：一次打包调用。"""

    def __init__(self, group, n_global, head_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.group, self.n_global, self.head_dim = group, n_global, head_dim
        self.qkv = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, 3 * n_global * head_dim, bias=False)
        self.proj = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, n_global * head_dim, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s_local, _ = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).view(b, s_local, self.n_global, 3 * self.head_dim)
        qkv = self.group.all_to_all_4d(qkv, mode=0)            # 第 1 次握手（输入侧）
        q, k, v = qkv.chunk(3, dim=-1)
        attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
            q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
        ).transpose(1, 2)
        attn = self.group.all_to_all_4d(attn.contiguous(), mode=1)  # 第 2 次握手（输出侧）
        return self.proj(attn.reshape(b, s_local, self.n_global * self.head_dim))


class ThreeCallAttention(torch.nn.Module):
    """q、k、v 各走一次 mode 0：同样字节，三次握手。"""

    def __init__(self, group, n_global, head_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.group, self.n_global, self.head_dim = group, n_global, head_dim
        self.qkv = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, 3 * n_global * head_dim, bias=False)
        self.proj = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, n_global * head_dim, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s_local, _ = x.shape
        # 同一个线性层输出，只是把「打包」推迟到交换之后：
        # (b, s_local, n_global, 3, head_dim) 再 unbind，与原实现 chunk(3, dim=-1) 取到
        # 完全相同的三组值——因为交换只重排 s 轴与 n 轴，从不碰最后一维。
        qkv = self.qkv(x).view(b, s_local, self.n_global, 3, self.head_dim)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(dim=3)                            # 各 (b, s_local, n_global, head_dim)
        q = self.group.all_to_all_4d(q, mode=0)                # 握手 1
        k = self.group.all_to_all_4d(k, mode=0)                # 握手 2
        v = self.group.all_to_all_4d(v, mode=0)                # 握手 3
        attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
            q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
        ).transpose(1, 2)                                      # (b, s_global, n_local, head_dim)
        attn = self.group.all_to_all_4d(attn.contiguous(), mode=1)  # 握手 4（输出侧只有一份张量）
        return self.proj(attn.reshape(b, s_local, self.n_global * self.head_dim))

# 实例精读：序列并行 DiT 注意力块

## 1. 本讲目标

前面几讲我们把 `all_to_all_4d` 的形状契约、错误检查与不均匀分片逐一拆开了。本讲换一个视角：**站在使用者一边**，逐段精读 [examples/dit_attention.py](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L1-L137) ——一个完整的、可训练的序列并行注意力块，看这些契约如何拼成一个真实模块。

读完本讲，你应该能：

1. 读懂 `UlyssesAttention` 的每一层职责：它是一个**普通的 `nn.Module`**，没有 `autograd.Function` 包装，两次 all-to-all 包夹一次 SDPA。
2. 解释 qkv 打包进最后一维（`3 * head_dim`）的动机与正确性：为什么是「一次握手搬三份张量」，以及为什么这种折叠是安全的、而另一种看似等价的折叠是陷阱。
3. 复现示例的双校验方法学：与「无序列并行的单卡参照」比较输出**和**输入梯度，理解为什么用 `allclose` 而不是 `equal`、容差为什么是 `5e-2`。
4. 说出五个优化器步想证明什么、不证明什么。
5. 完成综合实践：把一次打包调用拆成对 q、k、v 的三次独立调用，验证输出等价，并用 CUDA 事件或 `_timed` 量化「字节相同、握手次数不同」带来的时间差。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲默认你已读过 u1-l2（Ulysses 原理）、u2-l1（Group 构造）、u2-l2（形状契约）。三个本讲会用到的结论，先摆出来：

| 结论 | 出处 | 一句话回顾 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mode 0 把 \((b, s_{\text{local}}, n_{\text{global}}, d)\) 变成 \((b, s_{\text{global}}, n_{\text{local}}, d)\)，mode 1 是严格逆变换 | u1-l2 / u2-l2 | 两次交换都是纯字节搬运，往返位精确 |
| 一次同步调用的内部链路是 prepare → 屏障 → 传输 → 屏障 → copy_out | u1-l4 | **每次调用付两道与消息大小无关的握手屏障** |
| dtype 白名单 + \(d \times \text{elem\_size}\) 必须是 16 的倍数 | u2-l2 | bf16 的 elem_size 是 2 字节 |

再补两个本讲特有的术语：

- **SDPA**（scaled dot-product attention）：`torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention`，计算 \(\text{softmax}(QK^\top/\sqrt{d_k})V\)。关键性质是**按头独立**——每个头在自己的 \((s, d)\) 子空间里做注意力，头与头之间不交换数据。整块「三明治」结构之所以成立，靠的就是它（u1-l2 讲过）。
- **DiT**（Diffusion Transformer）：视频/图像扩散模型用的 Transformer 变体，长序列训练是其典型场景，也是本库的主要目标负载。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 本讲中的角色 |
| --- | --- |
| [examples/dit_attention.py](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L1-L137) | 主角：137 行完整示例——一个模块类、一个单卡参照、双校验、五个优化器步 |
| [docs/migration.md](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L1-L243) | 从 DeepSpeed / sglang / yunchang 迁移的视角；本讲引用它的「结构性差异」「qkv 打包」「autograd 无需包装」三段 |
| [python/fast_ulysses/group.py](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L111-L119) | Python 门面：`all_to_all_4d` 签名（L111-L119）与 `_timed` 阶段计时（L251-L265），综合实践要用 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 模块结构：一个普通的 `nn.Module`

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

DeepSpeed、sglang、yunchang 都交付一个**注意力模块**（`DistributedAttention` / `UlyssesAttention` / `LongContextAttention`），由它持有 q/k/v 交换、注意力调用和输出交换。fast-ulysses 只交付**集合通信本身**——你用两次调用加上自己的注意力内核替换掉那个模块。这是迁移文档开门见山强调的结构性差异：[docs/migration.md:6-10](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L6-L10)，而 `examples/dit_attention.py` 就是这种形态的完整样例（[docs/migration.md:157-163](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L157-L163)）。

这个模块最值得注意的「结构」是它**没有结构**：没有 `autograd.Function` 包装、没有手写 backward。因为 `all_to_all_4d` 在 C++ 里就是可微的，backward 是另一个 mode，包装器被「删除」而不是「翻译」过来（[docs/migration.md:149-155](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L149-L155)）。所以它长得和任何一个单卡注意力块一模一样——这正是示例 docstring 的第一条说明（[examples/dit_attention.py:5-8](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L5-L8)）。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

一次前向的数据流（形状以默认配置 ws=8 为例，常量在 [examples/dit_attention.py:29](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L29)：`B=1, S_LOCAL=512, HEADS_PER_RANK=4, HEAD_DIM=128`，故 \(n_{\text{global}} = 4 \times 8 = 32\)，隐藏维 \(= 32 \times 128 = 4096\)）：

```text
x                    (1, 512, 4096) = (b, s_local, n_global·head_dim)   ← 调用方已有的序列分片
 ├─ Linear qkv + view → (1, 512, 32, 384)      打包：最后一维 = 3·head_dim
 ├─ all_to_all_4d(mode=0) → (1, 4096, 4, 384)  交换：序列分片 ⇄ 头分片
 ├─ chunk(3, dim=-1) → q/k/v 各 (1, 4096, 4, 128)
 ├─ SDPA（按头独立，全序列本地算）→ (1, 4096, 4, 128)
 ├─ all_to_all_4d(mode=1) → (1, 512, 32, 128)  换回：头分片 ⇄ 序列分片
 └─ Linear proj → (1, 512, 4096)               输出仍是「本 rank 的序列分片、全部头」
```

输入输出契约是对称的：进出都是调用方自己那段序列分片、全部的头，模块内部（两次集合通信之间）才看到全序列＋头分片——类 docstring 写明了这一点（[examples/dit_attention.py:33-37](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L33-L37)）。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

构造函数只做三件事：记下 group、把两个投影层建成普通 `nn.Linear`（[examples/dit_attention.py:39-43](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L39-L43)）。注意 `qkv` 这一个 Linear 的输出宽度是 \(3 \cdot n_{\text{global}} \cdot \text{head\_dim}\)——打包在权重层面就定好了，后面的 `view` 只是 reshape，不搬运数据（[examples/dit_attention.py:50](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L50)）。

forward 主体在 [examples/dit_attention.py:45-63](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L45-L63)，每一步旁边的注释就是文档：

- mode 0 调用带注释「Differentiable; its backward is mode 1」（[L52-L53](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L52-L53)）；
- SDPA 需要 \((b, \text{heads}, s, d)\) 布局，所以前后各一次 `transpose(1, 2)`（[L56-L59](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L56-L59)）；
- mode 1 之前显式写了 `.contiguous()`（[L62](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L62)）——其实算子内部本来就会做连续化，自己写一遍不改变任何事（[docs/migration.md:140-142](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L140-L142)），这里写出来是为了让 L63 的 `reshape` 读起来显然合法。

另外注意 `main()` 里构造 group 用了 `require_nvlink=False`（[examples/dit_attention.py:85](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L85)）。u2-l1 讲过该参数的语义；migration.md 也说明这个开关「是为测量那种拓扑准备的，不是为在其中运行」（[docs/migration.md:219-221](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L219-L221)）。示例没有注释这一选择，一个合理的解读是：演示脚本希望在任何单机拓扑上都能跑起来，不被 NVLink 检查拦住；生产训练应保持默认 `True`。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践：形状追踪

1. **实践目标**：把 4.1.2 的形状表在真实运行里逐行对上号。
2. **操作步骤**：把 `examples/dit_attention.py` 拷贝一份（例如 `my_dit.py`，不要改动仓库原文件），在 `forward` 里插入三行打印（示例代码）：

   ```python
   # 示例代码：加在 forward 内部的形状追踪
   r = dist.get_rank()
   print(f"[r{r}] x        {tuple(x.shape)}")
   print(f"[r{r}] qkv pre  {tuple(qkv.shape)}")   # mode 0 之前
   print(f"[r{r}] qkv post {tuple(qkv.shape)}")   # mode 0 之后（qkv 被重新赋值过）
   ```

   然后用任意进程数运行（ws 不必是 8，任何 \(N \ge 1\) 都行，`n_global` 会自动变为 \(4N\)）：

   ```bash
   torchrun --nproc_per_node=2 my_dit.py
   ```

3. **需要观察的现象**：ws=2 时应看到 `qkv pre (1, 512, 8, 384)`、`qkv post (1, 1024, 4, 384)`——序列轴从 512 变 1024、头轴从 8 变 4，两轴相乘不变。
4. **预期结果**：形状表逐行吻合；`x` 与最终返回值形状相同。无 GPU 时无法用 nccl 后端运行，此实践**待本地验证**。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

1. **问**：为什么模块的输出是 `(b, s_local, n_global·head_dim)`，而不是含全序列的形状？
   **答**：mode 1 已经把头分片换回了序列分片；模块的输入输出契约是对称的——调用方自始至终只持有自己的序列分片和全部的头，整条序列只在两次集合通信**之间**存在（[examples/dit_attention.py:33-37](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L33-L37)）。
2. **问**：一个 DeepSpeed 用户要把 `DistributedAttention(local_attn, sp_group)` 迁移过来，模块层面要补什么、删什么？
   **答**：补——对 `local_attn`（自己的注意力内核）的显式调用和两次 `all_to_all_4d`；删——`_SeqAllToAll` 那个 `autograd.Function` 包装，`all_to_all_4d` 本身可微，包装器直接删除（[docs/migration.md:48-56](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L48-L56)）。
3. **问**：为什么 `UlyssesAttention` 在构造时保存 group，而不是每次 forward 新建一个？
   **答**：group 持有对称内存窗口、plan 缓存和 comm 流，构造又是集合操作；正确纪律是建一次、长期持有（[docs/migration.md:233-238](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L233-L238)）。

### 4.2 qkv 打包：一次握手搬三份张量

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

注意力需要 q、k、v 三份张量走同一趟交换。最直接的写法是对三者各调一次集合通信；本示例（以及 migration.md 推荐的形态）把三份沿最后一维拼成一个 `3 * head_dim` 的最后轴，**一次调用搬完**。示例 docstring 的收尾段专门强调这一点（[examples/dit_attention.py:15-16](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L15-L16)）：one handshake instead of three, for the same bytes。迁移表里对应的一行也是同一个意思：DeepSpeed 的三次 `_SeqAllToAll.apply`（q、k、v 各一次）在这里变成 `3 * head_dim` 最后轴上的一次调用（[docs/migration.md:52](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L52)）。

为什么「字节不变却更快」？因为成本分两类：

- **按字节计费的带宽项**：传输 \(b \cdot s_{\text{local}} \cdot n_{\text{global}} \cdot 3d \cdot \text{elem}\) 字节——拼与不拼总量相同（ws=8 默认配置下是 \(1 \times 512 \times 32 \times 384 \times 2 = 12{,}582{,}912\) 字节 ≈ 12.6 MB）。
- **按次数计费的延迟项**：每次调用两道握手屏障 + 一次 copy_out，与消息大小基本无关。

打包省的是第二类。粗略模型：

\[
T_{\text{调用}} \approx 2\,T_{\text{屏障}} + T_{\text{传输}}(\text{字节}) + T_{\text{copy\_out}}
\]

输入侧打包 1 次调用付 \(2\) 道屏障，拆开 3 次付 \(6\) 道；输出侧两种写法都只有一份注意力输出，都是 1 次调用。整层合计：**2 次调用 / 4 道屏障 vs 4 次调用 / 8 道屏障**，字节完全一样。综合实践（第 5 节）会实测这个差。

正确性依赖一个关键事实：**`all_to_all_4d` 只重排 s 轴与 n 轴，从不混合最后一维**。因此「先交换后按最后一维 chunk」与「先按最后一维拆开再各自交换」取出的是同一组值——最后一维的任何切分都与交换可交换。这保证了 chunk 出的 q/k/v 与三次独立交换的结果逐位相同。

折叠的位置也讲究。把 \((b, s, 3, n, d)\)（yunchang 的 5D 形态）免费 reshape 成 \((b, s, 3n, d)\) 看起来同样「打包了三份」，但 migration.md 明确标记它是陷阱：偶均分会沿合并后的 \(3n\) 轴切出**连续块**，每个 rank 收到的是「q 的某几个头 + k 的某几个头 + v 的某几个头」的混合物，而不是「同一批头的完整 q/k/v」（[docs/migration.md:143-145](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L143-L145)）。折叠进**最后一维**则不动 \((s, n)\) 两轴，rank 收到的仍是完整的头分片。示例因此让投影层直接以 \(3 \cdot n \cdot d\) 的输出顺序「上游就地发射」这个布局（[docs/migration.md:138](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L138)）。

对齐也顺手核对：u2-l2 的规则是 \(d \times \text{elem\_size}\) 须为 16 的倍数；这里参与交换的最后一维 \(d = 3 \times 128 = 384\)，bf16 下 \(384 \times 2 = 768\)，\(768 \bmod 16 = 0\)，合法。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
Linear 输出 (b, s_local, n_global·3·head_dim)          ← 权重层面已经按 [头][3·head_dim] 排好
  └─ view → (b, s_local, n_global, 3·head_dim)          ← 纯 reshape，零拷贝
  └─ all_to_all_4d(mode=0)                              ← 一次握手搬三份
  └─ chunk(3, dim=-1) → q/k/v                           ← 交换缓冲上的跨步视图，零拷贝
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

- 打包与交换：[examples/dit_attention.py:48-53](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L48-L53)——注释直说「q, k, v packed into the last axis so the two collectives below stay two collectives」（两次集合通信保持为两次），L50 的 `view` 完成打包，L53 一次 mode 0 搬完。
- 交换后拆包：[examples/dit_attention.py:55](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L55)——`chunk(3, dim=-1)` 拿到三个跨步视图，不复制数据。
- migration.md 推荐形态的等价片段：[docs/migration.md:32-42](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L32-L42)——与示例逐行对应，注释同样点出「two collectives stay two collectives」。

#### 4.2.4 代码实践：验证「最后一维切分与交换可交换」

这个实践**不需要 GPU、不需要本库**，纯 torch 在 CPU 上就能完成，同时复用你在 u1-l2 实践里写过的 mode 0 模拟。

1. **实践目标**：证明「先交换后 chunk」与「先拆开后交换」取出同一组值——这正是三次独立调用能替换打包调用的正确性依据。
2. **操作步骤**（示例代码）：

   ```python
   # 示例代码：纯 CPU 验证最后一维切分与 mode 0 交换可交换
   import torch

   def mode0_shards(x, ws):
       """返回每个 rank 的 mode 0 输出：全序列 × 该 rank 的头分片。"""
       b, s, n, d = x.shape
       s_l, n_l = s // ws, n // ws
       outs = []
       for r in range(ws):
           seq_shards = [
               x[:, rr * s_l:(rr + 1) * s_l, r * n_l:(r + 1) * n_l, :]
               for rr in range(ws)
           ]                                   # 源 rank rr 的序列分片 × rank r 的头分片
           outs.append(torch.cat(seq_shards, dim=1))
       return outs

   ws, b, s, n, hd = 4, 1, 32, 8, 16
   x = torch.randn(b, s, n, 3 * hd)            # 打包形态：最后一维 3·hd

   a = mode0_shards(x, ws)                     # 路径 A：先交换
   a_q = [t.chunk(3, dim=-1)[0] for t in a]    #        后按最后一维取 q

   q, k, v = x.view(b, s, n, 3, hd).unbind(dim=3)
   b_q = mode0_shards(q.contiguous(), ws)      # 路径 B：先拆出 q，再交换

   assert all(torch.equal(p, c) for p, c in zip(a_q, b_q))
   print("chunk 与交换可交换：成立")
   ```

3. **需要观察的现象**：断言通过；两条路径对每个 rank 的 q 逐位相等。
4. **预期结果**：必然通过——交换是纯置换，且只作用于 s、n 两轴。这个「参照重放」的验证思路与 `test/test_plan.py` 用主机端参照核对 plan 的做法同源（u3-l3 会精读）。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

1. **问**：若 `head_dim=100`、dtype 为 bf16，打包后的调用合法吗？不打包呢？
   **答**：都不合法。对齐约束作用于参与交换的最后一维：打包 \(3 \times 100 = 300\)，\(300 \times 2 = 600\)，\(600 \bmod 16 = 8 \ne 0\)；不打包 \(100 \times 2 = 200\)，\(200 \bmod 16 = 8 \ne 0\)。两者都会被 u2-l2 讲过的对齐检查以 `RuntimeError` 拒绝——打包与否不改变约束本身，只决定要检查几次。
2. **问**：`(b, s, 3, n, d) → (b, s, 3n, d)` 的免费 reshape 为什么是陷阱，而 `(…, 3·head_dim)` 为什么安全？
   **答**：前者把 3 折进了会被均分切开的 n 轴，每个 rank 收到的连续块里混着 q/k/v 各自的一部分头；后者只加宽不被切分的最后一维，rank 收到的仍是「同一批头 × 完整的 q/k/v 三段」（[docs/migration.md:143-145](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L143-L145)）。
3. **问**：ws=8 时，打包与不打包两种写法的整层调用次数、屏障次数各是多少？
   **答**：打包 = 输入侧 1 次 + 输出侧 1 次 = 2 次调用、4 道屏障；q/k/v 拆开 = 3 + 1 = 4 次调用、8 道屏障（每次调用 barrier_in + barrier_out 两道，见 [python/fast_ulysses/group.py:264](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L264) 的阶段名）。与 ws 无关。

### 4.3 参照对照：输出与梯度双校验

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

「交换是字节级置换」在单元测试里可以位精确，但一个真实的注意力块仍可能把张量接错轴——比如 mode 0 之后没 chunk 对位置、或转置转错轴，数据照样被搬运、测试照样「通过」。所以示例的校验不测集合通信本身，而是**测整个模块的行为**，并且测两样东西：前向输出和**输入梯度**。对照物是一个无序列并行的参照——同一个模块实例、同一份权重，一个 rank 上拿全序列算一遍（[examples/dit_attention.py:66-74](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L66-L74) 的 `reference` 函数，与 `forward` 唯一的区别就是没有两次 all_to_all）。docstring 把这层用意说得很直白（[examples/dit_attention.py:10-13](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L10-L13)）。

双校验的三个方法学要点：

1. **同一份数据**：全局输入在各 rank 上用同一份随机数构造再切片，参照算的就是「并行路径实际消费的那份数据」（[examples/dit_attention.py:88-94](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L88-L94)）。
2. **同一份权重**：各 rank 同种子初始化保证权重跨 rank 一致（[L82](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L82)）；参照直接复用 `block` 实例，且比较发生在任何 `opt.step()` 之前，权重逐位相同。
3. **allclose 而非 equal**：两条路径喂给 SDPA 的批布局不同（参照一次算 \(n_{\text{global}}\) 个头，并行路径每 rank 算 \(n_{\text{local}}\) 个头），且并行路径的 q/k/v 是交换缓冲的跨步视图、参照的是密集张量，浮点归约顺序不同必有微小差异。代码注释原话："attention is not a permutation, and the two paths reduce in different orders"（[examples/dit_attention.py:99-101](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L99-L101)）。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`main()` 中校验段落的顺序（顺序本身有讲究）：

1. 并行路径前向 + 反向：`y_local = block(x_local)`、`y_local.sum().backward()`（[L96-L97](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L96-L97)），得到分片输出与 `x_local.grad`。
2. `dist.all_gather` 收集全部分片输出与全部分片梯度（[L102-L105](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L102-L105)）——用的是普通 `torch.distributed` 集合通信，校验基础设施不必也是被测物。
3. 参照路径前向 + 反向：`reference(block, x_global)`、`.sum().backward()`（[L107-L108](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L107-L108)），得到 `y_ref` 与 `x_global.grad`。
4. rank 0 上沿序列轴 `cat` 后做两个最大绝对误差：输出误差与梯度误差，先 `.float()` 再相减，阈值为 `tol = 5e-2`（[L110-L116](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L110-L116)）。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

- 参照函数：[examples/dit_attention.py:66-74](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L66-L74)——与 `forward` 逐行同构，只少两次 `all_to_all_4d`；`module.qkv`/`module.proj` 复用的是同一个模块的权重。
- 数据构造：[examples/dit_attention.py:88-94](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L88-L94)——`x_global` 先 `requires_grad_(True)`，再 `detach()` 切片后给 `x_local` 也加 `requires_grad_(True)`：两套叶子各自攒各自的梯度，互不干扰。
- 比较与容差：[examples/dit_attention.py:110-116](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L110-L116)——`.float()` 把 bf16 升到 float32 再求差；`tol = 5e-2` 旁的注释给出量纲依据："bfloat16 through attention plus two projections"（bf16 精度 + 注意力 + 两次投影的合理上限）。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践：ws=1 的退化运行

1. **实践目标**：在最小环境下跑通校验，并解释 ws=1 与 ws=8 两个误差数字的差别来自哪里。
2. **操作步骤**：单卡即可运行（nccl 后端仍需一块 GPU）：

   ```bash
   torchrun --nproc_per_node=1 examples/dit_attention.py
   ```

3. **需要观察的现象**：头部打印 `ws=1 s_global=512 n_global=4`；两行误差均应显示 `0.0000 OK`。
4. **预期结果**：ws=1 时两条路径执行的是**同一串算子、同一布局**（mode 0 在 ws=1 不改变形状，参照与并行路径的 chunk 都是同一缓冲上的同跨步视图），因此误差应精确为 0；ws≥2 时误差变为「非零但小于 5e-2」。两个数字对比正好把 4.3.1 的第 3 点（差异来自注意力归约顺序，而非交换本身）钉死。**待本地验证**。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

1. **问**：为什么相减前要把两边都 `.float()`？
   **答**：bf16 只有约 3 位十进制有效数字，在 bf16 里做减法本身就会把误差舍入掉；升到 float32 再取最大绝对误差，得到的才是有意义的误差度量（[examples/dit_attention.py:111-112](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L111-L112)）。
2. **问**：参照为什么复用 `block` 实例，而不是同种子再 new 一个？
   **答**：比较的前提是权重逐位相同。复用实例（且比较先于任何 `opt.step()`）把这一点变成结构性保证，而不是靠「种子相同」这个间接条件；种子相同在 L82 解决的是另一个问题——各 rank 之间权重一致。
3. **问**：把判据改成 `torch.equal` 会怎样？
   **答**：几乎必然失败。交换本身位精确，但两条路径的 SDPA 头数批布局不同、q/k/v 一个跨步一个密集，浮点归约顺序不同产生微小差异——这正是注释选 allclose 的原因（[examples/dit_attention.py:99-101](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L99-L101)）。

### 4.4 训练循环：五个优化器步

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

校验回答的是「一次前向 + 一次反向对不对」；训练循环回答的是另一个问题——**「能训练吗」**。一个集合通信可以在单测里位精确，却仍被接进错误的轴，导致梯度流断掉或炸掉，只有真实的优化器步能暴露这类问题。docstring 的最后一句话就是这个意思（[examples/dit_attention.py:12-13](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L12-L13)）。

循环本身平平无奇：AdamW、固定随机目标、5 步 `mse_loss`。两个不平凡的点：

- **梯度自动穿过两次集合通信**。`loss.backward()` 触发 mode 1 的 backward（= mode 0）和 mode 0 的 backward（= mode 1），两次反向交换由 C++ 算子的 autograd 公式自动完成——这正是 4.1 说「没有包装器」的另一面。数学细节（为什么 vjp 是逆排列、splits 为何不交换）留到 u6-l3。
- **loss 是 rank 本地的**。每个 rank 的 `mse_loss` 算的是自己序列分片对同一份随机目标的误差；各 rank 数字不同、也不应相同。这段循环证明「模块在训练」，不产生任何全局指标（[examples/dit_attention.py:126-129](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L126-L129) 的注释明说 ranks are not meant to agree）。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
构建 AdamW(block.parameters(), lr=1e-3) 与固定 target
循环 5 次:
    zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    loss = mse_loss(block(x_local), target)   ← 两次正向交换
    loss.backward()                            ← 两次反向交换（另一个 mode）
    opt.step()
    rank 0 打印本 rank 分片的 loss
最后: block.group.destroy() → dist.destroy_process_group()   ← 顺序不可换
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

- 循环本体：[examples/dit_attention.py:118-129](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L118-L129)——`target = torch.randn_like(y_local)` 在循环**外**创建并固定，模块拟合的是这一个确定目标，loss 才应该单调下降。
- 收尾顺序：[examples/dit_attention.py:131-132](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L131-L132)——`destroy()` 是集合操作（u2-l1：先同步 comm 流、再组内 barrier），必须先于 `dist.destroy_process_group()`，否则在 group 还活着时拆掉它脚下的进程组。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践：确认梯度在流动

1. **实践目标**：亲眼确认反向传播确实穿过了两次集合通信。
2. **操作步骤**：在你拷贝的 `my_dit.py` 里，把 `y_local.sum().backward()` 之后加两行（示例代码）：

   ```python
   # 示例代码：检查输入梯度穿过了两次集合通信
   assert x_local.grad is not None, "梯度没有穿过 all_to_all"
   print(f"[r{rank}] |x_local.grad| = {x_local.grad.norm().item():.4f}")
   ```

   运行 `torchrun --nproc_per_node=<N> my_dit.py`。
3. **需要观察的现象**：断言不触发；5 步 loss 大体下降（模块在拟合固定目标）；各 rank 的梯度范数不同。
4. **预期结果**：若把两次 `all_to_all_4d` 误接到错误的轴上，最典型的症状就是 `x_local.grad` 为 `None` 或全 0——这个断言是最便宜的烟雾测试。具体数值**待本地验证**。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

1. **问**：`loss.backward()` 时两次 `all_to_all_4d` 各自的反向发生了什么？
   **答**：mode 0 的 backward 是 mode 1、mode 1 的 backward 是 mode 0，splits 原样传递不交换——由算子的 autograd 公式自动执行，示例里的两行注释（[L52](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L52)、[L61](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L61)）就是全部需要手写的文档（另见 [docs/migration.md:149-155](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L149-L155)；推导在 u6-l3）。
2. **问**：rank 0 打印的 loss 各 rank 相同吗？应该相同吗？
   **答**：不同、也不应相同。loss 是本 rank 序列分片对固定目标的 MSE，分片内容各 rank 不同；这段循环的目的是证明「能训练」，不是给出全局损失（[examples/dit_attention.py:126-129](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L126-L129)）。
3. **问**：把 `block.group.destroy()` 挪到 `dist.destroy_process_group()` 之后会怎样？
   **答**：`destroy()` 内部要做组内 barrier 并清理窗口与 comm 流，此时底层进程组已被拆掉，轻则报错重则挂起；u2-l1 讲过它是集合操作，顺序不可换（[examples/dit_attention.py:131-132](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L131-L132)）。

## 5. 综合实践

把第 4 节的四条线串起来：**将示例的打包调用改成三次独立调用，先证等价、再量化代价、最后解释原因**。

### 5.1 实践目标

1. 验证：q/k/v 三次独立 `all_to_all_4d` 与一次打包调用，输出逐位（或 allclose 意义上）一致。
2. 量化：同样字节下，4 次调用对 2 次调用多付的时间，并用 `_timed` 的阶段分解指出时间去了哪。
3. 解释：写出「为什么字节相同但时间不同」的注释。

### 5.2 操作步骤

将下面的完整脚本（示例代码）保存为仓库根目录的 `dit_attention_3calls.py`（新文件，不改仓库源码），运行：

```bash
torchrun --nproc_per_node=<N> dit_attention_3calls.py    # 计时请在 ws>=2 下进行
```

```python
# 示例代码：三次独立调用 vs 一次打包调用
from __future__ import annotations

import os

import torch
import torch.distributed as dist
import torch.nn.functional as F

from fast_ulysses import UlyssesGroup

B, S_LOCAL, HEADS_PER_RANK, HEAD_DIM = 1, 512, 4, 128


class PackedAttention(torch.nn.Module):
    """与 examples/dit_attention.py 的 UlyssesAttention 相同：输入侧一次打包调用。"""

    def __init__(self, group, n_global, head_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.group, self.n_global, self.head_dim = group, n_global, head_dim
        self.qkv = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, 3 * n_global * head_dim, bias=False)
        self.proj = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, n_global * head_dim, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s_local, _ = x.shape
        qkv = self.qkv(x).view(b, s_local, self.n_global, 3 * self.head_dim)
        qkv = self.group.all_to_all_4d(qkv, mode=0)                 # 握手 1/2（输入侧仅此一次）
        q, k, v = qkv.chunk(3, dim=-1)
        attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
            q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
        ).transpose(1, 2)
        attn = self.group.all_to_all_4d(attn.contiguous(), mode=1)  # 握手 2/2
        return self.proj(attn.reshape(b, s_local, self.n_global * self.head_dim))


class ThreeCallAttention(torch.nn.Module):
    """q、k、v 各走一次 mode 0：同样字节，多两次握手。权重与 PackedAttention 共享。"""

    def __init__(self, group, n_global, head_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.group, self.n_global, self.head_dim = group, n_global, head_dim
        self.qkv = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, 3 * n_global * head_dim, bias=False)
        self.proj = torch.nn.Linear(n_global * head_dim, n_global * head_dim, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        b, s_local, _ = x.shape
        # 同一个 Linear 的输出，只是把「打包」推迟：view 成 (…, n, 3, head_dim) 再 unbind，
        # 取到的三组值与原实现「先交换后 chunk(3, dim=-1)」完全相同——
        # 因为交换只重排 s 轴与 n 轴，从不混合最后一维（见 4.2.4 的纯 torch 验证）。
        qkv = self.qkv(x).view(b, s_local, self.n_global, 3, self.head_dim)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(dim=3)                  # 各 (b, s_local, n_global, head_dim)
        q = self.group.all_to_all_4d(q, mode=0)      # 握手 1/4
        k = self.group.all_to_all_4d(k, mode=0)      # 握手 2/4（同流串行，窗口复用是安全模式）
        v = self.group.all_to_all_4d(v, mode=0)      # 握手 3/4
        attn = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
            q.transpose(1, 2), k.transpose(1, 2), v.transpose(1, 2)
        ).transpose(1, 2)                            # (b, s_global, n_local, head_dim)
        attn = self.group.all_to_all_4d(attn.contiguous(), mode=1)  # 握手 4/4（输出只有一份张量）
        return self.proj(attn.reshape(b, s_local, self.n_global * self.head_dim))


def bench(module, x, iters=20):
    for _ in range(5):          # 预热：触发新形状的集合性窗口分配与 SDPA 内核选择
        module(x)
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    start, end = torch.cuda.Event(True), torch.cuda.Event(True)
    start.record()
    for _ in range(iters):
        module(x)
    end.record()
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    return start.elapsed_time(end) / iters     # 毫秒


def main():
    dist.init_process_group("nccl")
    rank, ws = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
    torch.cuda.set_device(int(os.environ.get("LOCAL_RANK", rank)))
    dev = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
    torch.manual_seed(0)

    n_global = HEADS_PER_RANK * ws
    group = UlyssesGroup(require_nvlink=False)
    packed = PackedAttention(group, n_global, HEAD_DIM).to(dev, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    three = ThreeCallAttention(group, n_global, HEAD_DIM).to(dev, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    three.load_state_dict(packed.state_dict())   # 权重逐位相同：差异只能来自路径本身

    s_global = S_LOCAL * ws
    x = torch.randn(B, s_global, n_global * HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
    x_local = x[:, rank * S_LOCAL:(rank + 1) * S_LOCAL]

    # 1) 等价性：同样权重、同样字节，输出应一致
    with torch.no_grad():
        err = (packed(x_local).float() - three(x_local).float()).abs().max().item()
        t_packed, t_three = bench(packed, x_local), bench(three, x_local)

        # 2) 阶段分解：_timed 把一次调用切成 barrier_in/transfer/barrier_out/copy_out
        big = torch.randn(B, S_LOCAL, n_global, 3 * HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
        small = torch.randn(B, S_LOCAL, n_global, HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
        for t in (big, small):                   # 先预热：新形状首调会触发集合性窗口分配
            group.all_to_all_4d(t, mode=0)
        _, st_big = group._timed(big, mode=0)    # 打包形态 d=384 的一次调用
        _, st_small = group._timed(small, mode=0)  # 拆开形态 d=128 的一次调用

    if rank == 0:
        print(f"ws={ws}  max |packed - three| = {err:.6f}")
        print(f"packed : {t_packed:.3f} ms/iter")
        print(f"three  : {t_three:.3f} ms/iter  ({t_three / t_packed:.2f}x)")
        print(f"packed d=384 stages (ms): { {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in st_big.items()} }")
        print(f"single d=128 stages (ms): { {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in st_small.items()} }")

    # 为什么字节相同、时间不同：
    # 输入侧要搬运的总字节都是 b*s_local*n_global*3*head_dim*elem_size，但每次
    # all_to_all_4d 都要付两道与消息大小基本无关的标志位屏障（barrier_in/barrier_out）
    # 和一次 copy_out——这些是按「次数」计费的延迟项；传输本身才是按字节计费的带宽项。
    # 打包把输入侧 3 次调用（6 道屏障、3 次 copy_out）合并为 1 次（2 道屏障、1 次
    # copy_out），省下的是 4 道屏障加 2 次 copy_out 的固定延迟，带宽项一分未变。
    # 注意：ws=1 时屏障被整体跳过（u1-l3），这项差异归零——计时请在 ws>=2 下做。
    group.destroy()
    dist.destroy_process_group()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

### 5.3 需要观察的现象

- 等价性一行：`max |packed - three|` 应为 0 或极小（两条路径喂给 SDPA 的 q/k/v 一个是交换缓冲的跨步视图、一个是密集张量，SDPA 可能选不同内核，故用与示例一致的宽容差判断；建议同时打印 `torch.equal(...)` 看是否碰巧逐位相等）。
- 计时两行：`three` 的每次迭代应慢于 `packed`，比值大于 1。
- 阶段分解两行：`d=384` 与 `d=128` 两次调用的 `transfer` 大致与字节成比例（约为 3 倍关系），而 `barrier_in`/`barrier_out` 两次都接近同一个「与大小无关」的小常数——这就是延迟项与带宽项的分界。`_timed` 的阶段名与定义见 [python/fast_ulysses/group.py:251-265](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/python/fast_ulysses/group.py#L251-L265)（阶段数值为毫秒，与 [benchmark/bench_a2a.py:198](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/benchmark/bench_a2a.py#L198) 的用法同口径；注意 docstring 标明它仅供基准、读事件会同步）。

### 5.4 预期结果

- 输出等价成立（4.2.4 已从「交换不碰最后一维」给出结构性论证）。
- 慢的幅度由 4 道额外屏障 + 2 次额外 copy_out 的固定延迟决定；消息越小（本例仅约 12.6 MB），延迟项占比越大，比值越难看。具体数字**待本地验证**——请在 ws≥2、空闲的 GPU 上运行并记录。
- 若把 `--nproc_per_node=1` 跑一遍：等价性仍成立，但两个版本耗时几乎相同——因为 ws=1 时屏障被整体跳过，延迟项消失。这个「负对照」本身就是对「时间差来自握手」的交叉验证。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `examples/dit_attention.py` 是本库推荐形态的完整样例：fast-ulysses 只交付集合通信，注意力内核与两次调用的编排归调用方；模块因此是普通 `nn.Module`，没有 `autograd.Function` 包装。
- qkv 沿最后一维打包成 \(3 \cdot \text{head\_dim}\)：字节不变、输入侧握手由 3 次并为 1 次；正确性依赖「交换只重排 s/n 轴、从不混合最后一维」，故与最后一维的任何切分可交换；折叠进 n 轴的 5D 变体则是混头的陷阱。
- 校验方法学：与同权重、同数据的单卡参照比较输出**和**输入梯度；`allclose` 而非 `equal`（差异来自 SDPA 的归约顺序，不是交换本身）；先 `.float()` 再求差，容差 `5e-2` 对应 bf16 穿过注意力加两次投影的量纲。
- 五个优化器步证明的是「能训练」而非「一次正确」；梯度自动穿过两次交换（backward = 另一个 mode），loss 是 rank 本地量。
- 成本模型：\(T_{\text{调用}} \approx 2T_{\text{屏障}} + T_{\text{传输}}(\text{字节}) + T_{\text{copy\_out}}\)——打包优化的是按次数计费的延迟项，不是带宽项。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

下一讲进入 u3 单元：**u3-l1（A2ADims / CopyOp / A2APlan：寻址的纯主机表达）**。本讲你一直把 `all_to_all_4d` 当黑盒用；u3 将打开 [src/a2a_plan.cc](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/src/a2a_plan.cc#L1-L1) 所在的纯主机层，看「序列⇄头重排」如何被编译成一组带源/目的步长的字节拷贝——其中 mode 0 的发射逻辑正是本讲那次打包调用的真身。

顺路可读：

- [docs/api.md](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/api.md#L1-L1) 的 Raises 全表——把本讲用到的契约再对一遍；
- u6-l3 将给出「backward 是另一个 mode」的完整推导，回答本讲 4.4 遗留的为什么；
- [benchmark/bench_a2a.py](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/benchmark/bench_a2a.py#L1-L1) 的 `stages` 模式（u9-l4 精读）——本讲综合实践里 `_timed` 的工业版用法。

# 实例精读：序列并行 DiT 注意力块

## 1. 本讲目标

前面几讲我们把 `all_to_all_4d` 的形状契约、错误检查与不均匀分片逐一拆开了。本讲换一个视角：**站在使用者一边**，逐段精读 [examples/dit_attention.py](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L1-L137) ——一个完整的、可训练的序列并行注意力块，看这些契约如何拼成一个真实模块。

读完本讲，你应该能：

1. 读懂 `UlyssesAttention` 的每一层职责：它是一个**普通的 `nn.Module`**，没有 `autograd.Function` 包装，两次 all-to-all 包夹一次 SDPA。
2. 解释 qkv 打包进最后一维（`3 * head_dim`）的动机与正确性：为什么是「一次握手搬三份张量」，以及为什么这种折叠是安全的、而另一种看似等价的折叠是陷阱。
3. 复现示例的双校验方法学：与「无序列并行的单卡参照」比较输出**和**输入梯度，理解为什么用 `allclose` 而不是 `equal`、容差为什么是 `5e-2`。
4. 说出五个优化器步想证明什么、不证明什么。
5. 完成综合实践：把一次打包调用拆成对 q、k、v 的三次独立调用，验证输出等价，并用 CUDA 事件或 `_timed` 量化「字节相同、握手次数不同」带来的时间差。

## 2. 前置知识

本讲默认你已读过 u1-l2（Ulysses 原理）、u2-l1（Group 构造）、u2-l2（形状契约）。三个本讲会用到的结论，先摆出来：

| 结论 | 出处 | 一句话回顾 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mode 0 把 \((b, s_{\text{local}}, n_{\text{global}}, d)\) 变成 \((b, s_{\text{global}}, n_{\text{local}}, d)\)，mode 1 是严格逆变换 | u1-l2 / u2-l2 | 两次交换都是纯字节搬运，往返位精确 |
| 一次同步调用的内部链路是 prepare → 屏障 → 传输 → 屏障 → copy_out | u1-l4 | **每次调用付两道与消息大小无关的握手屏障** |
| dtype 白名单 + \(d \times \text{elem\_size}\) 必须是 16 的倍数 | u2-l2 | bf16 的 elem_size 是 2 字节 |

再补两个本讲特有的术语：

- **SDPA**（scaled dot-product attention）：`torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention`，计算 \(\text{softmax}(QK^\top/\sqrt{d_k})V\)。关键性质是**按头独立**——每个头在自己的 \((s, d)\) 子空间里做注意力，头与头之间不交换数据。整块「三明治」结构之所以成立，靠的就是它（u1-l2 讲过）。
- **DiT**（Diffusion Transformer）：视频/图像扩散模型用的 Transformer 变体，长序列训练是其典型场景，也是本库的主要目标负载。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 本讲中的角色 |
| --- | --- |
| [examples/dit_attention.py](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/examples/dit_attention.py#L1-L137) | 主角：137 行完整示例——一个模块类、一个单卡参照、双校验、五个优化器步 |
| [docs/migration.md](https://github.com/triple-mu/fast-ulysses/blob/ad1a4a06a42d8129a278f010b1d67a6e206d38e6/docs/migration.md#L1-L243) | 从 DeepSpeed / sglang / yunchang 迁移的视角；本讲引用它的「结构性差异」「qkv 打包」「autograd 无需包装」三段 |
